notes: A8 is retained solely as the verified publication baseline.
The next release is 1.0.0; status is recomputed by scripts/check_release_readiness.py.
No 1.0.0 gate is satisfied without current reproducible evidence or human review.

gates.title: Release commit has a clean working tree
Execution semantics are complete
gates.detail: Streaming, execution identity, idempotency and same-snapshot composition have current local evidence, including direct-actor, nested deadline/cancellation, telemetry-tree, stream-refusal, idempotency-isolation and adversarial-recursion checks; release review remains required.

gates.title: Performance budgets are enforced
gates.detail: docs/performance/budgets.json holds 13 calibrated limits covering dependency injection, policy evaluation, execution identity, idempotency, nested invocation, streaming, compile scaling and compile memory. Budgets are ratios between scenarios measured in the same run, calibrated over three runs whose spread was 1.01x-1.19x, and enforced by scripts/check_performance_budgets.py in the CI Performance budgets job. The gate was demonstrated to fail on a real regression (idempotency_miss 2.61x over budget with the pre-fix store) and to pass on the current tree. Budgets were calibrated on one developer machine; runner behaviour and maintainer approval of the limits remain required.

gates.title: Interoperability conformance is demonstrated
gates.detail: ADR 0094 Version-pinned host fixtures include local Starlette 1.6.0, FastAPI 0.141.1, Django 6.1.1 and selected conditional Litestar 2.24.0 evidence. The optional SQLAlchemy 2.0.54 SQLite fixture proves host-owned Session/commit/rollback decisions across success, refusal, failure, cancellation, nesting and parallel sessions; PostgreSQL is NOT RUN because it is conditional. FastAPI 0.141.1 plus optional OpenTelemetry SDK 1.44.0 in-memory export additionally prove a host-owned trace joined by nested capability spans, isolated in parallel and redacted across complete, streaming and cancellation paths. No framework, ORM or exporter support claim follows. Maintainer review remains required.

gates.title: Security program is reviewed
gates.detail: An adversarial review covering authorization/principal, nested invocation, idempotency, streaming/SSE, documentation UIs, supply chain and telemetry produced one finding (S-1: a streaming invocation silently discarded an idempotency selector), now fixed with regression tests in tests/security/test_trust_boundaries.py. Probes that behaved correctly are recorded in docs/THREAT_MODEL.md section 10. No fuzzing, penetration test or concurrency/load test was performed; maintainer release review remains required.
